title: Saliency-Guided Replay for Continual Learning in Deep Spiking Neural Networks
abstract: arXiv:2610.17998v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Spiking Neural Networks (SNNs) are promising for energy-efficient neuromorphic computing, but they still suffer from catastrophic forgetting when learning tasks sequentially. This work investigates the integration of Experience Packing and Replay (EPR) as a memory-efficient continual learning strategy for deep SNNs under low-latency constraints. The proposed framework combines Batch Normalization Through Time stabilized VGG9 SNNs with Spike Activation Maps (SAM), which provide forward-only explanations based on spike activity. These explanations are temporally aggregated into spatial attention maps and used to select the most informative image patches for replay, instead of storing full images. Experiments on Split CIFAR10 and Split CIFAR100 show that SAM-guided EPR improves the accuracy-memory trade-off under tight memory budgets, and remains competitive while requiring substantially less storage.

translated_title: 显著性引导的重放方法用于深度脉冲神经网络的持续学习
translated_abstract: 脉冲神经网络（SNN）在节能的神经形态计算领域前景广阔，但在按顺序学习任务时仍会遭受灾难性遗忘问题。本工作研究了将经验打包与重放（EPR）作为低延迟约束下深度脉冲神经网络的一种内存高效持续学习策略。所提出的框架将经过时间维批归一化稳定的VGG9脉冲神经网络与脉冲激活图（SAM）相结合，后者提供基于脉冲活动的仅前向传播解释。这些解释在时间维度上聚合为空间注意力图，并用于选择信息量最大的图像块进行重放，而无需存储完整图像。在Split CIFAR10和Split CIFAR100上的实验表明，SAM引导的EPR在严格的内存预算下改善了准确率与内存之间的权衡，并且在所需存储量大幅减少的情况下仍保持竞争力。
tldr: 该论文提出利用脉冲激活图（SAM）生成空间注意力图，仅选择信息量最大的图像块而非完整图像进行重放，在严格内存预算下显著改善了深度脉冲神经网络持续学习的准确率-存储权衡。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes saliency-guided experience replay using Spike Activation Maps (SAM) to select only the most informative image patches instead of full images, improving the accuracy-memory trade-off for continual learning in deep spiking neural networks under tight memory budgets.
